title: Replicator fails the second time is executed
description:
### Please confirm

- [x] I have searched existing issues to check if an issue already exists for the bug I encountered.

### Distribution

Ubuntu

### Distribution version

24.04 LTS

### Output of `snap list --all lxd core20 core22 core24 snapd`

```shell
root@micro1:~# snap list --all lxd core20 core22 core24 snapd
Name    Version      Rev    Tracking       Publisher   Notes
core24  20260317     1587   latest/stable  canonical✓  base
lxd     git-83beb32  39247  latest/edge    canonical✓  in-cohort
snapd   2.75.2       26865  latest/stable  canonical✓  snapd
```

### System info

kernel_version: 6.8.0-106-generic
driver_version: 6.0.0 | 10.2.1
server_version: "6.8"
storage: cephfs | zfs | ceph

### Instance log

N.A.

### Expected behavior

The replicator is designed to run multiple times, creating a new snapshot and transferring the incremental data during each execution. 

### Actual behavior

The replicator fails consistently starting from the second run.

### Steps to reproduce

1. For the environment setting, follow the same steps described in https://github.com/canonical/lxd/issues/18204.
2. Launch a container or a VM and run replicator twice `lxc replicator run replicator`.
3. The second time replicator fails (see the attached log)
```
root@micro1:~# lxc replicator run replicator
Error: One or more child operations failed
```

[journalctl.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/27200071/journalctl.txt)


### Information to attach

- [ ] Any relevant kernel output (`dmesg`)
- [ ] Instance configuration (`lxc config show <instance> --expanded`)
- [ ] Main daemon log (at `/var/log/lxd/lxd.log` or `/var/snap/lxd/common/lxd/logs/lxd.log`)
- [ ] If a lxc command fails, output of the command with `--debug`
- [x] Output of the daemon with `--debug` (or use `lxc monitor` while reproducing the issue)
